data.name: Ajitaabh
data.gender_notes: Ajitaabh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ajitaabh is a compound name derived from Ajita and Bh. Ajita means 'unconquerable, invincible, unyielding, and unvanquished'. Bh means 'lord'. Hence, Ajitaabh can be interpreted as 'The Unconquerable Lord'. The name Ajitaabh carries the meaning “Unconquerable, Invincible” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ajitaabh usually hope their child will grow to embody unconquerable, invincible and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of strength and resilience, Ajitaabh inspires courage and perseverance.
data.etymology: Ajitaabh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Unconquerable, Invincible.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajitaabh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
